day_local: Talaadada Usbuuca Labaatanaad iyo Sagaalaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, jacaylka Ilaah, iyo wadaagga Ruuxa Quduuska ah ha idinla jiraan.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Rabbigu wuxuu dadkiisa u sheegaa nabad.
homily:
Waxaa jira saacado maalinta ka mid ah, gaar ahaan markii qorraxdu ay bilaabato inay hoos u dhacdo, oo gurigu uu noqdo mid aamusan, halkaas oo xusuustu ay si tartiib ah u soo gasho qolka. Waxaad arki kartaa wax yar oo maalinle ah: laga yaabee inay tahay diyaarad yar oo uu Ben ku ciyaari jiray, ama buug uu dhigay miiska, ama xataa xusuusta qosolkiisa markuu ka hadlayo 'con chim airlines'. Waxyaalahan yaryar, oo aan muhiim u muuqan, ayaa ah meesha aan maanta ka bilaabayno. Waxay yihiin xusuus muujinaysa in nolosha Benjamin Vo ay ahayd mid dhab ah, mid qurux badan, oo weli halkan nala joogta. Waxaan maanta dooraneynaa hal sawir oo nala socda: waa sawirka 'derbiga' ama 'kala qaybsanaanta' ee Bawlos uu ka hadlayo akhriska koowaad. 

Bawlos wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in Masiixu uu 'jebiyey derbiga kala qaybinta ee colnimada'. Waxaan u baahannahay inaan sawirkan si qoto dheer u eegno. Derbiyada nolosheenna waxaa ka mid ah xanuunka, kala fogaanshaha, iyo dareenka ah inaan keligeen nahay. Laakiin Masiixu wuxuu dhexda u galay derbigaas si uu inoo mideeyo. Benjamin wuxuu ahaa wiil fahmay midnimada. Bal ka feker sida uu ugu taagnaa Ryan garabkiisa, sida uu ugu raaxaysan jiray inuu la safrayo qoyskiisa, oo uu ula qaybsado dunida. Wuxuu ahaa wiil leh maskax aad u fiiqan, oo yaqaanay sida loo darsado AWS environments, ama sida loo qoro koodhka GitHub, laakiin wuxuu kaloo ahaa wiil arkayay waxa dadka kale aysan arag: baahida dadka kale iyo jacaylka qoyskiisa. 

Laakiin intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si daacad ah u wajahno xanuunka weyn ee maanta halkan yaalla. Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo qoto dheer oo culayskooda wata. Waxaa jira saacado marka qorraxdu dhacdo ama marka gurigu aamuso, oo aad dareemaysaan inaysan jirin wax buuxin kara cisrigaas banaanka ah. Waxaan rabaa inaan halkan ku hakinno. Waxaan rabaa inaan idiin sheego runta: Ilaah wuu idin arkaa. Wuxuu arkaa oohintiinna, wuxuu arkaa dadaalkiinna, wuxuu arkaa jacaylka aad weli u hayso Ben. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaan rabaa inaan si gaar ah u xuso in xanuunkan uusan ahayn khaladkiinna. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwa weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents' (Midna isagu midna waalidkiis). Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah.

Oo halkaas ayay nuurku ka soo galayaa qolka mugdiga ah. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Gird your loins and light your lamps and be like servants who await their master’s return.' (Suunkaaga xiro, oo laambadahaaga shid, oo noqo sida addoommo sugaya sayidkooda). Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil mar walba diyaar u ahaa inuu dadka kale la wadaago waxa uu haysto. Xusuusnow sida uu u rabay inuu u huro lacagtiisa si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa dabeecadda wiilkan qalbiga wanaagsan. Taasi waa waxa ay ka dhigan tahay in lagu dhex noolaado xornimada Masiixa. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil loo doortay inuu iftiimiyo adduunkan. Hadda, Ben wuxuu ku jiraa meel ka sarreysa daruuraha, meel aanay jirin xanuun ama daal. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven'. Ma jiro baahi loo qabo inuu dhisayo 'con chim airlines', waayo wuxuu ku jiraa meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, isagoo dhoola caddaynaya.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaaga, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Wuxuu rabaa inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay: 'Ha ka baqina, waayo waxaan idin sugayaa meel aan dhimasho lahayn.'

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in derbiyada colnimada ay Masiixu jebiyeen, oo aad hadda ku jirtaan qoyska Ilaah. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka ugu barakaysan. Waxaan kaa jeclahay wax kasta, waxaanna rabaa inaan naftayda kuu dhiibo. Maadaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin Eucharist-ka, fadlan igu soo booqo ruuxa qalbigayga. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii inaad horey u joogtay, waxaanna naftayda kuu hurayaa gebi ahaanba. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa fogaado. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin dhawro, oo wejigiisa ha idinku iftiimiyo. Nabadda Masiix ha idinla jirto had iyo goor.
petition_call: Waxaan Rabbiga u ducaysanaa annagoo leh:
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii ka horreeyey ee dhintay, ha ku nastaan iftiinka Masiixa.
Dhammaan kuwa murugaysan, Ilaah ha u qalbi qaboojiyo oo ha siiyo rajo iyo nabad.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal, xilligaas waxaad tihiin kuwo aan Masiix lahayn, oo laga gooyey bulshada reer binu Israa'iil, oo ah shisheeyayaal ku saabsan axdiyada ballanka, iyagoon rajo lahayn, oo aan Ilaah lahayn dunida. Laakiin hadda, xagga Masiix Ciise, idinka oo mar hore fogayd, waxaad ku soo dhawaateen dhiigga Masiix. Waayo, isagu waa nabaddayada, oo labadii wuxuu ka dhigay mid, oo wuxuu dumiyey derbiga colnimada ee kala qaybinayey, isagoo jidhkiisa ku baabbi'iyey sharcigii iyo amarradii iyo qawaaniintii, si uu naftiisa uga abuuro hal qof oo cusub oo labadii beddela, isagoo nabadda dhisaya, oo labadaba Ilaah kula heshiisiinaya hal jidh, isagoo iskutallaabta ku baabbi'inaya colnimada. Wuxuu u yimid inuu nabadda u wacdiyo idinka oo fog iyo kuwa u dhowba, waayo isaga ayaannu labadeennuba ku helnaa marin aynu ku tagno Aabbaha hal Ruux. Haddaba, idinku ma tihidin shisheeyayaal iyo marti, laakiin waxaad tihiin muwaadiniin la jira quduusiinta iyo xubno ka mid ah reerka Ilaah, oo ku dhisnaa aasaaskii rasuulladii iyo nebiyadii, iyadoo Masiix Ciise laftiisu yahay dhagaxa madaxa. Isaga dhexdiisa ayaa dhismaha oo dhan laysugu xiraa oo u koraa macbud quduus ah oo Rabbiga ah; isaga dhexdiisa ayaad idinkuna kula dhisantaan si aad u noqotaan meel Ilaah kaga noolaado Ruuxa.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Rabbigu wuxuu dadkiisa u sheegaa nabad. Waxaan maqli doonaa waxa Ilaah ku dhawaaqayo; waayo Rabbigu wuxuu ku dhawaaqayaa nabad. Badbaadadiisu way u dhowdahay kuwa isaga ka cabsada, ammaan baa dalkeenna deggan. R. Rabbigu wuxuu dadkiisa u sheegaa nabad. Naxariis iyo run way kulmi doonaan; caddaalad iyo nabad way is-shumi doonaan. Run baa dhulka ka soo bixi doonta, caddaaladduna samada ayay ka soo eegi doontaa. R. Rabbigu wuxuu dadkiisa u sheegaa nabad. Rabbigu laftiisu wuxuu bixin doonaa barako; dalkeenna ayaa midhihiisa bixin doona. Caddaaladdu waxay ku socon doontaa hortiisa, badbaadaduna waxay raaci doontaa tallaabooyinkiisa. R. Rabbigu wuxuu dadkiisa u sheegaa nabad.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu xertiisii ku yidhi: “Suunkaaga xidha oo laambadahaaga shid, oo noqda sida addoommo sugaya sayidkooda oo ka soo noqonaya aroos, si ay isla markiiba u furaan markuu yimaado oo garaaco. Waxaa barakaysan addoommada uu sayidku helo iyagoo soo jeeda markuu yimaado. Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, wuxuu xidhan doonaa suunkiisa, wuxuuna fadhiisiin doonaa miiska, wuuna u adeegi doonaa. Haddii uu yimaado saacadda labaad ama tan saddexaad oo uu helo iyagoo sidaas u diyaarsan, waxaa barakaysan addoommadaas.”

day: Tuesday of the Twenty-ninth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!
